pageDescription: Answers to the questions we are asked most often.
searchPlaceholder: Type a word to filter the questions
otherLanguage: This answer does not exist in your language yet: it is shown in {lang}.
voteBusy: You have already given a lot of feedback. Please try again later.
formError: Oops, sending did not work. Please try again in a moment.
askIntro: Ask your question: the team will answer it and may publish the answer here.
askPlaceholder: Write your question in a sentence or two
askPrivacy: Please do not write your name, your e-mail or any other personal information: the answer will appear on this page, not by message.
askSent: Thank you! Your question has arrived. The answer may appear on this page.
askLimit: You have already asked several questions. Please try again later.
askInvalid: Your question did not go through. Write it in a few words, without a website address.
askFull: The question box is full for now. Please try again in a few days.
noneYet: The first answers are coming soon.
noneYetAsk: The first answers are coming soon. In the meantime, you can ask your question below.
mailSubject: New question on your FAQ page
mailThrottle: So as not to flood you, you receive at most one e-mail like this every 6 hours.
bannerNew: Visitor questions to handle: {count}. Open the “Received questions” tab.
draftsHelp: These answers are not visible on the site. Read them, then click “Publish”.
publishedNone: Nothing is published yet. Click “Add a question” to write the first one.
publishedNoneDrafts: Nothing is published yet. Read your drafts, then click “Publish”.
votesHint: Tip: some answers have more “Not really” than “It helped”. They may be worth rewriting.
confirmDeleteItem: Delete this question and its answer?
confirmUnpublish: Take this answer off the site? It becomes a draft again.
confirmDeleteTheme: Delete this category? Its questions are not deleted: they become “no category”.
confirmDismiss: Dismiss this received question? It will be erased.
confirmPublish: Publish this answer on the site?
themesHelp: Categories group the questions on the page. Change their order with “Move up” and “Move down”.
themesNone: No category yet: the questions are shown one after the other. Add a category (for example “Subscriptions”) to group them.
themeNameHelp: For example: Subscriptions. A name in one language is enough.
questionHelp: Write the question the way a visitor would ask it. One language is enough: the question then appears in that language (or, depending on your settings, in the other one with a note).
questionHelpLink: Write the question the way a visitor would ask it. One language is enough. Direct link to this question: {link}
answerHelp: You can write **bold**, *italics*, [a link](https://example.org) and lists (a line starting with “- ”). Keep the answer short.
themeHelpNone: You have no category yet: add one further down this page.
stateHelp: A draft stays invisible until you publish it.
resetHelp: This answer has {yes} “It helped” and {no} “Not really”. Tick this if you have just rewritten it.
errEmptyItem: Write at least a question and its answer, for example “When do you stream?”.
errAnswerMissing: The answer in {lang} is missing. Write it, or also empty the question in {lang} to leave it untranslated.
errQuestionMissing: The question in {lang} is missing. Write it, or also empty the answer in {lang} to leave it untranslated.
errNoPublishRight: You are not allowed to publish or take down an answer. Choose “Draft”.
errNotComplete: This question does not have a complete answer yet. Write the question and the answer in at least one language.
errNotFound: This question no longer exists. Reload the page.
errFull: Your page is full ({max} questions). Delete some before adding more.
errThemeName: Give the category a name, for example “Subscriptions”.
errThemesFull: You have reached {max} categories. Delete one before adding another.
errNoDraft: This received question has no draft yet. Click “Answer”.
okPublished: Published: the answer is visible on the site.
okUnpublished: Taken off the site: the answer is a draft again.
okThemeDeleted: Category deleted: its questions now have “no category”.
inboxHelp: These are the questions your visitors asked. They erase themselves after {days} days. Click “Answer”: the question becomes an answer that you publish. Visitors are never asked for personal information.
inboxNone: No question yet. When a visitor asks a question from your page, it appears here (and erases itself after {days} days).
inboxDraftHelp: A draft answer is ready for these questions (written by you or by the assistant). Read it, then publish it with one click.
markupInfo: Search engines: questions described to Google and the other engines: {count}.
markupPartial: Search engines: questions described to Google and the other engines: {count}. {omitted} are left out (answer too long or too many questions) but stay visible on the page.
